Account identity/revision events clear server inventory and selection and refresh; current-request and account-scope guards reject late success/error completions.

Read the unchanged storage scanner and its privacy fixture: it counts bytes and omits raw stored content. Existing synthetic path fixtures are unchanged. Doc Viewer header tests exercise explicit export callback and busy state; other document tests exercise rendering/copy helpers and canonical source structure.
